I do not think it is neccesary to control invasive speices. An invasive speice is defined as “an organism that is not indigenous or native, to a particular area” (Source 2, lines 1–2). Even though these speices can cause harm they can also do good.

One quote that shows [crossed out: illegible] it is not neccesary to control invasive speices is “Minor changes to a new ecosystem - an alein plant attracting pollinators to nearby native plants for example - might help individual from a native species without boosting their population numbers” (Source 1, line 41–43). This shows that while invasive speices can cause negative they can also cause lots of positive things to occur. If invasive speices a used right they could cause a bunch of good things to happen to boost ecosystems.

Another quote that proves it is not neccesary to control invasive speices is “As you read this, thousands of speices of plants, animals, fungi, and microbes have been or are being transported by humans to new locations, whether deliberately or inadvertantly” (Source 3, line 1–2). This shows that no matter how much people try to control invasive speices, the invasive species are always moving around and spreading so you cant contain enough of them. If they tried to contain all of them the would be wasting money and resources because they are always moving

One reason people think we should contain invasive speices is because “invasive speices can cause great economic and environmental harm to a new area” [crossed out: illegible] (Source 2, line 2). Even though this is true it would be

too hard to control all invasive speices and they could also produce a good outcome. If you controled all invasive speices you will never see the good they could do.

These quotes show why it is not neccesary to control invasive speices and that it would almost impossible to control them all. The speices might cause harm but there is also a chance they could cause good that humans never thought was possible. It is not worth the time, money, and people to control these speices because new ones will keep popping up so there is no way to control all invasive speices.
